add.name: post-writer
add.purpose: Writes LinkedIn posts in the user's own voice using about-me.md and voice.md profile files; turns context dumps (notes, transcripts) into posts.
add.how_to_use: Triggers on 'write a post', 'LinkedIn post'. Run voice-builder first to create the voice files.
add.evidence: 3.7k-star repo (Charlie Hills, MarTech AI newsletter); listed on skillsmp

add.name: voice-builder
add.purpose: Interviews the user and their samples to build about-me.md and voice.md, the voice profile every other skill in the pack reads.
add.how_to_use: Run once per user/project before post-writer or hook-generator.

add.name: gemini-carousel
add.purpose: Builds branded slide-by-slide LinkedIn carousels (1080x1350): design brief, approval gate, then per-slide Gemini image prompts.
add.how_to_use: Triggers on 'carousel', 'turn this into a carousel'. Image generation needs a Gemini key.
add.notes: No carousel skill in the current LinkedIn list.

add.name: hook-generator
add.purpose: Generates 6 two-line LinkedIn hook variations (40-char opener + contrast line) for a topic, using real numbers and first-person experience.

add.name: linkedin-content-writer
add.purpose: Evidence-led LinkedIn writing: create, rewrite, review, repurpose posts, comments and hooks from facts/notes, with a conversation-scoped writing profile.
add.how_to_use: Triggers on any LinkedIn writing request and its follow-ups. No API keys.
add.evidence: Microsoft (Power CAT) org repo; listed on mcpservers.org; 15 KB SKILL.md
add.notes: Low stars but vendor-org origin and substantive.
